    AI Overview
    Jennie Baranczyk is the head coach of the Oklahoma Sooners women's basketball team, a position she has held since April 2021. She has led the Sooners to four consecutive NCAA Tournaments, including consecutive Sweet 16 appearances in 2025 and 2026, and won two conference championships. 
    Key Details About Coach Baranczyk: 
    • Tenure: She was named the ninth head coach in program history on April 10, 2021, and is in her fifth season (2025–26).
    • Background: Before joining Oklahoma, she spent nine seasons as the head coach at Drake, where she had a 192–96 record
      .
    • Achievements: She has restored OU to a national standing, with a strong emphasis on team toughness and high-tempo play.
    • Playing Career: She played collegiately at Iowa. 
    She has led the team through a successful transition into SEC play, strengthening the program's reputation.
